responsibility: Implements text I/O and string conversion for ordinal numeric types in the boot runtime, covering reading and writing of CARDINAL and INTEGER values plus binary, octal, and hexadecimal conversions to and from fixed character arrays. It owns the parsing and formatting algorithms for these representations and uses StrIO for interactive text exchange, distinguishing it from FpuIO for floating-point formatting and from StringConvert’s DynamicStrings-based interfaces.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file for the GNumberIO pair: it contains the actual parsing and formatting code for decimal, hexadecimal, octal, and binary integer forms and the StrIO-based read/write helpers, whereas GNumberIO.h only lists the conversion and I/O entry points.
